hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations satisfy both entry thresholds, or if valid quotes are unavailable for the specified route and size. A pass is not acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model-invoice costs remain excluded from any full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: wPONS triangle exact-size probe at 0.02 WETH
hypotheses.rationale: Measured facts: the verified graph includes WETH → wPONS → PONS → WETH, using the wPONS–PONS pool and two WETH-linked pools. Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: testing this route at the supplied 0.02 WETH size may reveal an after-gas edge at this exact size; no training quote in the supplied cohort is asserted for this cell. Entry requires the current quote to meet the 20 bps edge floor and cover the configured 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. The configured improvement threshold is ignored for EXACT_EDGE.

hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations satisfy both entry thresholds, or if the required exact-size quotes cannot be obtained. A pass is not acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model-invoice costs remain excluded from any full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: wPONS triangle size-curve probe up to 0.02 WETH
hypotheses.rationale: Measured facts: the graph includes a WETH → PONS → wPONS → WETH triangle, and the menu offers a SIZE_CURVE cell capped at 0.02 WETH. Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: comparing every supplied exact size up to that cap may show a size-dependent after-gas net; the runner must select the greatest current after-gas net and must not scale quote outputs. Entry requires that selected quote to meet the 20 bps edge floor and cover the configured 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. This route and cell are not validated by the supplied training rows.

limitations: The supplied cohort is training evidence only; it does not validate forward outcomes for either proposed cell.
The ten-observation futility screen is a rejection screen, not the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate.
Quote opportunities are not fills, trades, inclusion, or earned returns; live strategy changes and deployment are not proposed.
The supplied graph and bounded discovery do not establish complete chain coverage.
analysis.summary: The cohort contains 80 observations with 480 measured quotes, but the supplied rows do not establish forward performance for the proposed route/size cells. The hypotheses below are bounded quote experiments, not forecasts of fills or claims of profitability. Retain the original control and the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate; a ten-observation screen can reject an unproductive idea but cannot establish acceptance. Unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model-invoice costs preclude a full-profit claim.
